LanguageData.CC_PEv_WorkGivenUp: {WORKER} gave up the work on {PAWN} and went home; whatever silver was paid for it is coming back.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_ChosenGone: The one the elder chose is no longer here.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_NoYoungBeast: The colony has no young beast worth half of theirs to trade.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_Impact_Beast: The young {1} is {0}'s: taught tameness and to follow, bonded to them, theirs to ride or load.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_Impact_BeastHome: {0} walks out to the beast and leads it home, and {1} stays the night to eat at the colony's table.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_Impact_BeastHomeBrief: Led home together, and a guest at supper
LanguageData.CC_PEv_Impact_TradeBrief: One of the colony's young beasts traded
LanguageData.CC_PEv_BeastHanded: {PAWN_nameDef} walked out to meet {BEAST}, and they are going home together. The elder chose well, {RIDER} says.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_BeastChronicle: {PAWN_nameDef} was given {BEAST}, a young beast the elder of {FACTION} chose for {PAWN_objective}.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_BeastTraded: {BEAST} is going back to the herders' grass with {RIDER}.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_PatientGone: The one they came for is no longer here.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_LimbFitted: That part has been seen to already.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_NoBed: The colony has no free bed for the fitting.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_Impact_Limb: {0} lies down at the colony's bed and is fitted with {1} for their {2}, by the order's surgeon with the game's own surgery.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_Impact_LimbRisk: {CHANCE}% that it takes. A failure is the game's own, injuries where the surgeon worked ({FAIL}% for {0}).
LanguageData.CC_PEv_Impact_Assist: {0} stands at {1}'s bedside for the fitting, and learns from the surgeon.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_Impact_AssistBrief: The colony's doctor at the bedside
LanguageData.CC_PEv_Impact_Owe: The colony owes {0} a favour for it, which they may call in one day.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_LimbDone: {SURGEON} has fitted {PAWN_nameDef} with {LIMB}, and wrote {PAWN_possessive} name into the Book of the Spared of {FACTION}.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_LimbFailed: The fitting did not take. {SURGEON} did what could be done for {PAWN_nameDef} and wrote the failure honestly in the order's book.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_StormPsylink: a first psylink, the storm's hum in their head
LanguageData.CC_PEv_StormTome: the {TOME}, and the storm to read it by
LanguageData.CC_PEv_ListenerGone: The one who hears the storm is no longer here.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_StormHeard: They already hear the storm in their own way.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_NoRod: The colony has no stormglass rod of its own to catch its storm at.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_VialName: a vial of the colony's storm
LanguageData.CC_PEv_Impact_Storm: {0} comes back from the storm with {1}.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_Impact_StormRod: {0} and {1} stand out in the rain by the colony's rod for an hour.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_Impact_StormOpen: {0} and {1} stand out in the open in the rain for an hour.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_Impact_StormRodBrief: An hour out in the storm
LanguageData.CC_PEv_Impact_Vial: A vial of the colony's own storm goes into the archive of {0}.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_Impact_VialBrief: The colony's storm in their archive
LanguageData.CC_PEv_StormWoke: A flash broke over {PAWN_nameDef} and {READER} out in the storm, and {PAWN_nameDef} came in with {WHAT}.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_StormChronicle: {PAWN_nameDef} stood an hour in a storm with a reader of the Conclave, and came in with {WHAT}.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_LinkerGone: The one they would link is no longer here.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_Impact_Mechlink: {0} has a mechlink from now, and the {1} is theirs to command.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_Impact_MechlinkBrief: A mechlink, and a mech to start
LanguageData.CC_PEv_Impact_MechlinkWork: {0} keeps still where they stand for two hours while {1} works, sparks and all.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_Impact_MechlinkWorkBrief: The mechlink put in where they stand
LanguageData.CC_PEv_Mechlinked: {TENDER} has put a mechlink into {PAWN_nameDef}, and {MECH} answers to {PAWN_objective} now.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_MechlinkedAlone: {TENDER} has put a mechlink into {PAWN_nameDef}. The mech that came with them did not stay.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_MechlinkChronicle: {PAWN_nameDef} was linked into the ways of {FACTION}: a mechlink, and a mech of {PAWN_possessive} own.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_NamedGone: The one the ledger named is no longer here.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_SeedChoose: Choose where the seed goes into the ground.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_SeedNoSpot: {X} walked the land and found nowhere the seed would take, and went home with it.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_Impact_Tree: A Gauranlen tree grows where it is planted, bound to {0}, its dryads in time.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_Impact_Grove: A grove of healroot is sown, and {0} learns it.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_Impact_Promise: The colony promises {0} a seedling for every tree it fells. Their ledger watches each season: kept, they warm to the colony; broken, it is a wrong.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_Impact_SeedOurs: The colony chooses the spot; {0} plants it there with {1} beside them.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_Impact_SeedHers: {0} chooses a quiet spot away from walls, and plants it with {1} beside them.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_SeedPlanted: {CARRIER} and {PAWN_nameDef} have planted the Gauranlen seed together, and the sapling is bound to {PAWN_objective}.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_GroveSown: {CARRIER} has sown a grove of healroot with {PAWN_nameDef}, who knows how to keep it now.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_SeedChronicle: {PAWN_nameDef} planted a Gauranlen seed from the ledger of {FACTION}, and the tree is bound to {PAWN_objective}.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_GroveChronicle: {PAWN_nameDef} sowed a healroot grove with a seed-carrier of {FACTION}.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_PromiseName: the promise of a seedling for every tree
LanguageData.CC_PEv_PromiseKept: The Mossborn of {FACTION} read the colony's page at the season's reckoning: {FELLED} trees felled and {PLANTED} planted. The promise is kept.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_PromiseBroken: The Mossborn of {FACTION} read the colony's page at the season's reckoning: {FELLED} trees felled and only {PLANTED} planted. The promise is broken, and the ledger says so.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_Means_truck: a truck sitting on a broken axle
LanguageData.CC_PEv_Impact_Trust: {1}'s porters carry {0} sealed crates in to the colony's stores, to be kept until a second caravan fetches them.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_Impact_TrustFee: About {0} silver at the fetch, if every crate is there.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_Impact_TrustFree: No fee: kept as friends (it would have been about {0} silver).
LanguageData.CC_PEv_Impact_TrustRisk: A crate opened, sold or gone at the fetch is red ink in their book: a grudge with {0}, and no league caravans for a season. Every crate there is good ink: better prices with every league for a year.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_CrateHeld: Held in trust for {FACTION} until a caravan fetches it, written in the Waystone Book by {MASTER}.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_BreakSealDesc: Open the crate and take what is inside. It was left in trust by {FACTION}, and their book will say so.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_BreakSealConfirm: This crate was left in the colony's care by {FACTION}. Opening it is red ink in their book: a grudge, and no league caravans for a season. Break the seal anyway?
LanguageData.CC_PEv_CrateOpened: The seal on a crate held in trust has been broken, and what it held lies on the floor.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_CrateBurned: A crate held in trust for {FACTION} has been destroyed. The league will hear how it happened.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_TrustLapsed: Nobody will come from {FACTION} for the crates they left now, and the colony's page in the Waystone Book is closed.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_InkGood: {X} of {FACTION} counted all {TOTAL} crates out of the colony's stores and wrote the colony in good ink. The league's fee of {FEE} silver is coming in, and every league will deal a little better with the colony for a year.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_InkGoodFree: {X} of {FACTION} counted all {TOTAL} crates out of the colony's stores and wrote the colony in good ink, with the mark of a friend's keeping beside it. Every league will deal a little better with the colony for a year.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_InkGoodForgiven: {X} of {FACTION} counted the crates out of the colony's stores. {BURNED} burned where they stood, which the book forgives, and the rest were all there: good ink, the fee of {FEE} silver, and better dealing with every league for a year.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_InkRed: {X} of {FACTION} counted the colony's {TOTAL} crates and found {WHAT}. The colony is written in red ink: a grudge, and no league caravan will come this way for a season.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_PlaceGone: The old place has been opened or read already.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_NothingToOpen: There is nothing there to open.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_NoRoomForCamp: There is no room on the land for another camp now.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_Impact_Measure: Two scholars camp by {0} for four days, measuring, then say exactly what lies inside.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_Impact_MeasureBrief: A camp beside the old place
LanguageData.CC_PEv_Impact_Open: At the end they break into {0}, and whatever sleeps there wakes: the game's own danger, whatever it is.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_Read_hives: {COUNT} insect hives with {INSECTS} insects asleep around them
LanguageData.CC_PEv_Read_caskets: {COUNT} ancient caskets, {SLEEPERS} of them with someone inside
LanguageData.CC_PEv_Read_crates: {COUNT} sealed crates of the old makers
LanguageData.CC_PEv_Read_nothing: nothing that sleeps or waits, only dust and old stone
LanguageData.CC_PEv_Read_land: what {NAME} is made of, and how it came to be there
LanguageData.CC_PEv_ReadingTitle: What lies in the old place
LanguageData.CC_PEv_Reading: The scholars of {FACTION} have finished measuring {OLDPLACE}. Inside, they say, there is {THING}.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_ReadingLand: The scholars of {FACTION} have finished measuring {OLDPLACE}, and wrote down {THING}.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_ReadingResearch: They left their notes with the colony: progress on {0}.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_ReadingOpened: They broke in as they left, as the colony let them. Nothing woke.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_ReadingOpenedDanger: They broke in as they left, as the colony let them, and what slept there is awake now. {X_nameDef} is running for the camp.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_HostelNoBread: There was no bread to send to the hostel this morning, and the travellers went without.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_HostelTraveller: {X_nameDef} of {THING} has stopped at the pilgrims' hostel for a night or two on the road.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_HostelTravellerNews: {X_nameDef} of {THING} stopped at the pilgrims' hostel with news from the road.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_HostelWords: {X_nameDef} and {THING}, travellers of peoples who don't get along, traded hard words at the hostel's fire before the fellowship parted them.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_HostelBrawl: {X_nameDef} and {THING}, travellers of peoples who don't get along, have come to blows at the hostel's fire.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_HostelCough: {PAWN_nameDef} came back from the blessing with the cough that has been going round the hostel's crowded hut.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_Impact_Bread: Food is carried out to the hostel's table every morning while it stands, meals if there are any, else raw food.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_Impact_BreadBrief: Bread for the hostel each morning
LanguageData.CC_PEv_Impact_Cough: {0} may catch the cough going round the crowded hut.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_BeastNotHere: The beast isn't on the land now.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_Impact_Trail: {0} goes out on the trail with two of the Wardens after {1}: the game's own hunt, side by side.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_PostWarns: The Wardens' hounds have the scent: {BEAST} is close to the colony's walls.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_PostFire: {BEAST} has come out of the dark to the Wardens' fire, and they are fighting it off by the lantern.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_PostHound: One of the Wardens' hounds, {THING}, ran off on the trail and hasn't come back.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_PostFell: {BEAST} has fallen, and the Wardens have put out their lantern to write its page.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_PostFellTogether: {BEAST} has fallen to the Wardens and the colony together. Its page will carry the colony's name, and one of them is skinning it where it lies.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_PostCold: The Wardens have lost {BEAST}'s trail, and say it has gone off the land.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_NoHandler: The colony has nobody who can handle beasts.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_NoBout: One of them has gone, and there is nobody to bout.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_Impact_SideHunt: The Wardens go after {0}, {1} with them, on the game's own hunt; its hide for their book, its meat for the colony.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_Impact_SideTame: {0} is marked for taming, and {1} tries to win it over the game's own way, with its food and its tries, the tamer beside them.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_Impact_Revenge: A failed try may turn {0} on whoever tried: {1} each time, the game's own chance.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_Impact_Bout: {0} and {1} settle it in a bout at the gate. The winner has {2}: the Wardens hunt it, or the tamer tries to win it over for the Circuit.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_BoutWarden: {WARDEN} put {TAMER} on the ground in the bout at the gate, and the Wardens are going after {BEAST}.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_BoutTamer: {TAMER} put {WARDEN} on the ground in the bout at the gate, and will try to win {BEAST} over for the Circuit.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_TamedOurs: {BEAST} is the colony's now, won over. {TAMER} of the Circuit is going home pleased.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_WonOver: {TAMER} has won {BEAST} over for the Circuit, and is leading it home.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_TameGaveUp: {TAMER} couldn't win {BEAST} over, and has gone home.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_TameRevenge: {BEAST} has turned on {TAMER} after a failed try at taming it.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_HeardHunt: Word on the roads: the colony gave {BEAST} to the hunt of {WARDENS}, and {CIRCUIT} took it badly.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_HeardTame: Word on the roads: the colony sided with {CIRCUIT} over {BEAST}, and {WARDENS} took it badly.
LanguageData.CC_PEv_HeardBout: Word on the roads: {WARDENS} and {CIRCUIT} settled {BEAST} in a bout at the colony's gate, and {WINNER} won it.
